sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('28d7ba00-f824-4e55-139a-03f509c099db', 'fee3bd4a-ade3-41fa-839a-48e9af69bcf4') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
